description: Get the latest successful compiled PDF for an explicit entry .tex path, with a signed download link valid for at most 10 minutes, size, generation time, and freshness information. This never compiles, waits, or polls. A newer running or failed compile may coexist with an older successful PDF. Freshness is unknown unless later source changes are detected; never assume the PDF matches current or unsaved source. Download and open the PDF using a PDF-capable tool before discussing its contents or layout; a link alone is not a PDF inspection. If no result exists or it has expired, ask the user to compile in the web app. Use read_file for uploaded PDF assets.

path.description: Project-relative entry .tex path, such as main.tex. Not a PDF path or URL.

name: read_pdf
title: Read an existing compiled PDF
